crossRefs.note: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and…
“ ‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall…
If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you…
Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

translations.web: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”
translations.bsb: Others were saying, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our homes to get grain during the famine.”
translations.kjv: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
translations.asv: Some also there were that said, We are mortgaging our fields, and our vineyards, and our houses: let us get grain, because of the dearth.
